eu_member_states.note: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. A code absent from this catalogue yields INDETERMINATE (never a silent 'not EU'). EEA treatment (NO/IS/LI) is deliberately false for CSRD direct scope; their national regimes belong in country packs.

accounting_directive_forms.note: Coarse v0 perimeter for Accounting Directive Annex I/II legal forms + Art. 1 extensions. Member-state-specific form mapping (GmbH, SAS, BV…) belongs in country packs; an unmapped form must route to analyst review, never silently out of scope.

ratified_country_packs.note: A Member State appears here (value true) ONLY after its country pack is expert-ratified. Until then S-013 keeps every final legal status at 'requires national review'. IE and DE stub packs exist under country-packs/ but are NOT ratified.

encoded_issuer_routes.note: Third-country issuer routes under the Transparency Directive (CSRD Article 2; Article 5(2), third subparagraph) that are encoded. No country's issuer route is encoded yet, so every lookup misses and CSRD-S-024 stays INDETERMINATE with source_status_unresolved: not yet covered, requires review (KNW-14). A country is added here only by the content change that encodes its route (CG-1); until then a non-EU result must never read 'does not apply'.
